$description: Portable sidebar baselines. CSS uses logical px; native maps the same baselines to points. Runtime colors remain owned by the existing theme CSS.

desktopRowHeight.$description: Desktop default density; small/large variants retain their existing sizes.

mobileRowMinHeight.$description: Touch row baseline; native rows may grow with Dynamic Type.

indent.$description: Native tree indentation; Web keeps its existing border/padding composition.

nativeLogoSize.$description: Native logo baseline; preserves the existing platform size.

brandFontSize.$description: Native brand baseline; Web brand retains its existing 16px style.

touchTargetSize.$description: Product target for custom native controls, distinct from the icon's visual size.
